title: Low-degree lower bounds via almost orthonormal bases
abstract: arXiv:2509.09353v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Low-degree polynomials have emerged as a powerful paradigm for providing evidence of statistical--computational gaps across a variety of high-dimensional statistical models [Wein25]. For detection problems---where the goal is to test a planted distribution $\mathbb{P}'$ against a null distribution $\mathbb{P}$ with independent components---the standard approach is to bound the advantage using an $\mathbb{L}^2(\mathbb{P})$-orthonormal family of polynomials. However, this method breaks down for estimation tasks or more complex testing problems where $\mathbb{P}$ has some planted structures, so that no simple $\mathbb{L}^2(\mathbb{P})$-orthogonal polynomial family is available. To address this challenge, several technical workarounds have been proposed [SW22,SW25], though their implementation can be delicate. In this work, we propose a more direct proof strategy. Focusing on random graph models, we construct a basis of polynomials

translated_title: 基于近似正交基的低阶多项式下界
translated_abstract: 低阶多项式已成为在多种高维统计模型中为统计-计算差距提供证据的有力范式[Wein25]。对于检测问题——即目标是将植根分布 $\mathbb{P}'$ 与具有独立成分的零假设分布 $\mathbb{P}$ 进行比较检验——标准方法是使用 $\mathbb{L}^2(\mathbb{P})$-规范正交多项式族来界定优势。然而，对于估计任务或更复杂的检验问题（其中 $\mathbb{P}$ 具有某种植入结构，因此不存在简单的 $\mathbb{L}^2(\mathbb{P})$-正交多项式族），这种方法会失效。为应对这一挑战，已有若干技术性变通方案被提出[SW22,SW25]，但其实现较为繁琐。在本工作中，我们提出了一种更直接的证明策略。聚焦于随机图模型，我们构造了一个多项式基
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于近似正交多项式基的更直接证明策略，用于在具有植入结构的随机图模型中建立低阶多项式下界，克服了传统规范正交多项式族方法在估计任务和复杂检验问题中的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a more direct proof strategy via almost orthonormal polynomial bases to establish low-degree lower bounds for random graph models with planted structures, overcoming the limitations of standard L²(P)-orthonormal polynomial family methods in estimation tasks and complex testing problems.
